question.text: If $x \frac{d y}{d x}+y=\frac{x f(x y)}{f^{\prime}(x y)}$, then $|f(x y)|$ is equal to

solution.text: $x \frac{d y}{d x}+y=\frac{x f(x y)}{f^{\prime}(x y)} \Rightarrow \frac{x d y+y d x}{d x}=\frac{x f(x y)}{f^{\prime}(x y)} \Rightarrow \frac{f^{\prime}(x y) d(x y)}{f(x y)}=x d x \Rightarrow \ln f(x y)=\frac{x^{2}}{2}+C \Rightarrow|f(x y)|=k e^{x^{2} / 2}$
